claimChecks.environment: Premier Cloud and Cloud Connected CMP
claimChecks.assessment: The current 8.8 aggregate Premier row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The renamed 8.8 task and earlier, separate 8.7 task both specify ES 8.7+ on Cloud. The current task requires the enabled assistant, investigation permission, an existing triaged finding, inherited connector access and separate granular asset permission where configured. It limits a detection burst to the first 10 findings and daily volume to approximately 200 per tenant, with frontier models only. CMP requires Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0; the overview adds Splunk AI Assistant 2.4+. The exact 2.3.6 installation/known-issue sources describe 2.4.0 Cloud Connected support as planned, so a released supported CMP path remains unverified.
